momawds_optimization.setting.preset.tool: Selects baseline distance thresholds, particle budgets, and server MSPT guard sensitivity.
momawds_optimization.setting.unfocused_f: Maximum FPS while the game window is unfocused. Minimized windows automatically drop to 1 FPS.
momawds_optimization.setting.item_frame_: Skips drawing 3D items and maps inside distant item frames while keeping the frame block visible.
momawds_optimization.setting.particle_go: Suppresses redundant ambient beacon and mob effect swirls in heavy scenes without altering gameplay visibility.
momawds_optimization.setting.xp_clumping: Lossless XP orb clumping (check server rules)
Off by default. Merges nearby XP orbs without losing points and removes XP pickup delay. Changes pickup/simulation behavior — check multiplayer server rules before enabling.
momawds_optimization.setting.tps_guard: Adaptive MSPT & explosion guard (check server rules)
momawds_optimization.setting.tps_guard.t: Off by default. Paces ambient wildlife ticks during server MSPT spikes and caps multi-TNT entity blast walks. Changes simulation behavior — check multiplayer server rules before enabling.
momawds_optimization.setting.hud_mode.to: Shows live FPS and integrated-server MSPT in a HUD corner, yielding automatically to F3.
Screen corner for the mini-HUD box. Automatically stacks cleanly with other HUD mods.
